suppress.notes: CVE-2026-119724 affects all Apache jclouds versions, including 2.7.0. Advisory: https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/11/02/3 Apache has retired jclouds and explicitly plans no fixed release; Maven Central's latest release is 2.7.0. No minor/patch upgrade (or major upgrade) fixes this issue. Accepted risk, not remediated: malicious provider XML responses can cause entity expansion/XXE, information disclosure and denial of service. Restrict access to trusted users and trusted provider endpoints pending migration to an alternative.

CVE-2026-123356 is incorrectly attributed to jetty-server 10.0.26 by OSS Index. Advisory: https://github.com/grobidOrg/grobid/security/advisories/GHSA-g2r5-4c8r-c84f Affected software is GROBID before 0.9.1: its /api/modelTraining endpoint leaks executor threads in GrobidRestProcessTraining, not Jetty server code. GROBID 0.9.1 fixes that application; no Jetty minor/patch upgrade addresses it. GROBID is not a dependency of these modules. This is a false positive, not an accepted Jetty vulnerability; unrelated Jetty risks remain separately governed by the existing shared suppression file.
